name: Gearbox
text: Choose **Mistral’s 8x22B mixture-of-experts** for EXCAVA’s core LLM workloads. It delivers near-top-tier performance at half the compute cost of dense models, freeing budget for faster iteration and more data. The trade-off is higher latency on some queries, but the speed gain in training and fine-tuning outweighs it for our use case.

name: Torque
text: Mistral’s 8x22B locks EXCAVA into a paid MoE stack—its free tier is capped, and the 8x GPU memory hit means we either overpay or throttle throughput. Swap it for **Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct**—free, dense, and tops benchmarks in its class with no vendor trap; if latency matters, run it on Cerebras CS-3’s free tier to test. Settle it with a 24-hour bake-off: same prompt set, same hardware, measure tokens/sec and accuracy—no opinions, just numbers.
